purpose: Triage and modify GitHub issues without duplicate or unauthorized writes.

trigger: Create a bug issue with reproduction steps
Triage this open issue and propose labels
Comment on issue 125 with the verified findings
do_not_trigger: Merge the code associated with the issue
Refactor a function in my local repository
Review a PDF document unrelated to GitHub

preflight: Resolve repository and exact issue number; search for duplicate issues first.
Do not scrape GitHub authentication tokens from local credential files.
Classify operations as read-only or remote writes before using tools.
workflow: Gather reproducer and relevant evidence before drafting.
Use narrow change sets for labels, comments and issue states.
For writes, request approval bound to exact issue and content.
Read back server state before reporting a successful update.

evidence.how_to_verify: Read exact repository, issue number, current state and labels.
Read new issue ID and title to confirm no duplicate publication.
Confirm the exact updated labels, comment or state on GitHub.

failure_modes: On duplicate or conflicting issue, stop and show the existing reference.
On API timeout, reconcile the issue state; do not repost blindly.
